name: GitHub Copilot app
desc: A desktop app that runs agent-driven development sessions.
desc_zh: 一个用来跑 Agent 开发会话的桌面应用。
solves: Agent work happens in a terminal you cannot see into. The app gives you canvases for the plan, the terminal and the browser, so progress stays visible and steerable.
solves_zh: Agent 干活发生在一个你看不见的终端里。这个应用把计划、终端和浏览器并成可双向操作的画布，进度看得见也拉得回来。
best_for: You want several agent sessions running in parallel, each on its own branch.
best_for_zh: 你想让多个 Agent 会话并行跑，各自待在自己的分支上。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — GitHub Changelog, https://github.blog/changelog/2026-05-14-github-copilot-ap）。 Technical preview 2026-05-14; generally available for macOS, Windows and Linux on 2026-06-17. Built natively on GitHub and distinct from GitHub Copilot in VS Code and from the Codex app. 首次公开日期来源：https://github.blog/changelog/2026-05-14-github-copilot-app-is-now-available-in-technical-preview/
